gaps.explanation: The Combining Statement of Revenues and Expenditures - General Fund Departments (trimmed pp11-12, printed p40) records transfers gross per department: General (119,890) out (detail index of the 'Transfers Out' -119,890 line), and Cemetery 3,489, Library 10,000, Park 3,303, Pool 3,996 in (total 20,788), Total column (99,102). The governmental funds statement (p5, printed p15) prints only the net 'Transfers to other funds' (99,102) in the General Fund column (the transfer to the Water Fund). Detail out 119,890 - statement 99,102 = 20,788 = the intra-General Fund department transfers in. Gross per department as printed; no fix.

No business-type schedule exists; the Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds (trimmed p7, printed p17) prints enterprise columns 'Water Fund' and 'Sewer Fund'. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 183,251 + interest income 292. Water: Sales 114,678 + Other revenue 1,050 + Interest income 292 = 116,020. Sewer: Sales 67,523. 0 + 116,020 + 67,523 = 183,543 = statement total.
